sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Driving Schools and Test Providers

FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A01
The substance course gates every never-licensed applicant yet also gates under-21 hardship return after low-BAL suspension [A01].
Why it matters: group substance-course; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F01, sec02-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A01
Improvement school is forced by crashes and convictions but elected for plain moving violations to dodge points [A01].
Why it matters: group improvement; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F03, sec02-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A01
Election needs a non-criminal, non-commercial ticket below 30 MPH over, and pays an 18 percent penalty cut [A01].
Why it matters: group improvement; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A02
Premium shelter covers one infraction but collapses on a second strike in 18 months, a third in 36, or 15 MPH over [A02].
Why it matters: group election-benefits; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec02-F05 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A02
Elections space 12 months apart with five per lifetime, and the clerk needs notice plus a fee inside 30 days [A02].
Why it matters: group election-limits; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F06 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A02
Advanced courses cure suspensions, DUI programs answer intoxication cases, and senior courses refresh drivers past 65 [A02].
Why it matters: group course-tracks; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F07, sec02-F08 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-R07 | anchor: A03
Service centers, school programs with random retests, and third parties all test, with minors online for knowledge only [A03].
Why it matters: group venues; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F10, sec02-F11 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-R08 | anchor: A03
Vision clears at 20/40, detours at 20/50, conditions 20/70 on the weaker eye, and always spans 130 degrees [A03].
Why it matters: group vision; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec02-F13 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-R09 | anchor: A04
The knowledge test spans 50 items across laws, safe practices, and control identification [A04].
Why it matters: group knowledge-exam; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F14 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec02-R10 | anchor: A04
The skills car must be plated, insured, and sound, failing on equipment, glass, tags, doors, seats, signals, or bumpers [A04].
Why it matters: group test-vehicle; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F15 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec02-R11 | anchor: A04
Maneuver numbers fix 50-foot backing, three-to-four-second gaps, and 100-foot signaled turns [A04].
Why it matters: group maneuvers; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F16, sec02-F17 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec02-R12 | anchor: A05
The three-point turn fits a 20-to-40-foot space with posture held throughout, and passing earns the license [A05].
Why it matters: group maneuvers; difficulty low; prereq sec02-R11; confusables sec02-F18 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0029]
